components.name: Pill
components.description: The one container for floating chrome.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 44px; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1117); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e8); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--pill-shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(15 17 23 / .08)); } .ds-pill-button { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 600 14px/1 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, transform .12s; } .ds-pill-button:hover { background: var(--context, #f3f3f6); } .ds-pill-button:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-pill-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b4bf0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent, #7b4bf0); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: 600 14px/1 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, transform .12s; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #4c25b8); } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b4bf0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg-track { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--context, #f3f3f6); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-seg { height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #626675); font: 600 13px/1 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg:hover { background: var(--context, #f3f3f6); } .ds-seg.active { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1117); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 17 23 / .12); } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b4bf0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Icon tool with a mono shortcut key; pressed state is the violet tint.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-top:-6px"><path d="M5 3l14 8-6 2-2 6z"/></svg><kbd>V</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-tool { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #626675); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, color .15s, transform .12s; } .ds-tool:hover { background: var(--context, #f3f3f6); color: var(--ink, #0f1117); } .ds-tool:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--selected, #f0eaff); color: var(--accent-deep, #5b2fd4); } .ds-tool kbd { position: absolute; bottom: 3px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font: 500 11px/1 'Roboto Mono', monospace; color: var(--muted, #626675); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b4bf0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Quiet search that grows and gains a violet border on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 176px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--context, #f3f3f6); border: 1px solid transparent; transition: width .15s, border-color .15s, background-color .15s; } .ds-search:focus-within { width: 248px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-color: var(--accent, #7b4bf0); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0f1117); font: 400 14px/1 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #686c7a); } .ds-search kbd { font: 500 11px/1 'Roboto Mono', monospace; color: var(--faint, #686c7a); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e8); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); }

components.name: Popover Menu
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 268px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e8); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgb(15 17 23 / .14); } .ds-menu button { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0f1117); font: 400 13px 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu button:hover { background: var(--selected, #f0eaff); } .ds-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b4bf0); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The canvas is the product. A full-bleed dotted map fills the viewport, and every piece of chrome floats over it as a small outlined pill: no header bar, no toolbar band, no bottom palette. The interface is Arabic-first and right-to-left, so "start" is the right edge. Near-black ink and neutral grays carry everything; one violet, taken from the logo's connection star, appears only where the user acts, selects or focuses.

Light and dark are a matched pair, not a theme and its inversion. The system follows the OS by default and can be pinned to light or dark; the pin is applied by an inline script before first paint so dark never flashes light.

Density is calm and workmanlike. Table cards are outlined, flat and uniform, so the topic band, the wires and the selection are the only things that change.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed dotted canvas; chrome is pills and one tool strip only.
Flat outlined surfaces with one soft pill shadow; no hard offset shadows.
One violet, reserved for primary action, selection and focus.
Noto Sans Arabic for UI, Roboto Mono only for identifiers, types and shortcut keys.
Topic color appears as information (a 3px band), never as decoration.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is for the primary action, selection and focus. There is no second accent; topic colors are data, not accent.

rules.name: The Context Stays Rule
rules.body: Selecting a table or relation emphasizes it, but surrounding tables and wires stay visible (dimmed wires keep 55% opacity).

rules.name: The Literal Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Roboto Mono is for identifiers, types, counts and shortcut keys only. Never set interface prose in it.

rules.name: The Outline First Rule
rules.body: A boundary is a 1px outline before it is a shadow. Nodes carry no resting shadow at all.

dos: Do use violet only for the primary action, selection and focus.
Do keep context visible around the selection: dim, never hide, neighboring tables and wires.
Do keep table geometry synchronized between CSS and `public/ui.js` (320px width, 1px border, header and row heights).
Do carry topic identity as a 3px inset band on the table header; it is information, not decoration.
Do put every new floating control in a pill, in the zone its role belongs to.
Do set identifiers, types, counts and shortcut keys in Roboto Mono and everything else in Noto Sans Arabic.
Do design every new color token as a light and dark pair, in all three theme blocks.
donts: Don't add a second accent color.
Don't add a header bar, a toolbar band or a bottom palette.
Don't add kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't give nodes a resting shadow or use hard offset shadows.
Don't thicken the node border above 1px or change node header and row heights in CSS alone.
